title: Trees Are Made of Air
hook: A giant tree is built from air, not from soil.
script: A giant tree is built from air, not from soil. Plant a seed in a pot of soil, and the soil barely loses any weight. The missing mass came out of the sky, as carbon dioxide. So how does a tree turn gas into wood? Leaves catch sunlight and use it to stitch carbon atoms into sugar. Those sugars are stacked into the long fibres that make up the trunk. What happens to all that carbon when a tree burns? It goes straight back up, so a forest is sky turned solid, for a while.
